items.title_en: Show HN: Super Dario
items.title_zh: Show HN：超级达里奥
items.summary_en: Shows a browser-based game with a compact codebase. This open-source demo demonstrates that polished gameplay can emerge from small tooling, serving as a solid reference for browser game development.
items.summary_zh: 展示一个浏览器端的游戏，代码体积紧凑且易于上手。这个开源示例证明了无需繁琐工具也能实现精良的玩法，是浏览器端游戏开发的有力参考。

items.title_en: Zig Creator Calls Spade a Spade, Anthropic Blows Smoke
items.title_zh: Zig 创作者直言不讳，Anthropic 敷衍其词
items.summary_en: An outspoken Zig language creator takes a blunt stance on AI safety claims associated with Anthropic, challenging the industry’s framing and transparency. The controversy underscores the tension between ambitious safety promises and practical concerns from developers who build on AI tools. It highlights how independent voices can shape public scrutiny of AI vendors.
items.summary_zh: Zig 语言的创作者对 Anthropic 的 AI 安全说法发表直言，挑战行业的表述与透明度。此事凸显了安全承诺的宏大叙事与开发者对 AI 工具的实际关切之间的张力。独立声音可能影响对 AI 供应商的公众监督。

items.title_en: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
items.title_zh: 苹果新 SpeechAnalyzer API 与 Whisper 对比基准
items.summary_en: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API is benchmarked against Whisper and Apple's own older speech API. The results highlight on-device performance, latency, and accuracy tradeoffs, offering insights into when to choose cloud vs. on-device processing for voice apps.
items.summary_zh: 苹果新推出的 SpeechAnalyzer API 经过与 Whisper 及前代 API 的对比基准测试，凸显了设备端与云端推理的权衡。评测聚焦准确率、延迟和噪声鲁棒性，为构建本地化语音应用提供实用参考。

items.title_en: LAPD lets contract with surveillance giant Flock expire
items.title_zh: LAPD 与 Flock 合同到期
items.summary_en: The LAPD's contract with surveillance giant Flock has expired amid civil-liberties concerns surrounding facial recognition and surveillance. The move signals a shift toward greater oversight of urban CCTV tech and could influence future procurement decisions.
items.summary_zh: LAPD 让与监控巨头 Flock 的合同到期，源于对隐私与公民自由的担忧。此举可能推动对城市级监控的问责与采购决策调整，并影响未来的安防生态。

items.title_en: Grok uploaded my user directory to xAI's servers
items.title_zh: Grok 将我的用户目录上传至 xAI 的服务器
items.summary_en: A user reports that Grok uploaded their home directory to xAI's servers, raising serious privacy concerns about data leakage in AI tooling. The incident underscores the need for strict ignore lists and local-first defaults when using CLI tools.
items.summary_zh: 用户声称 Grok 将其家目录上传到了 xAI 的服务器，暴露出 AI 工具数据外泄的重大隐患。事件强调在使用 CLI 工具时应设定严格的忽略清单与本地优先策略，避免意外暴露敏感信息。

items.title_en: Grok CLI uploaded the whole home directory to GCS
items.title_zh: Grok CLI 将整个主目录上传至 GCS
items.summary_en: Grok CLI reportedly uploaded the entire home directory to Google Cloud Storage, exposing sensitive files and configuration. The incident highlights the risk of broad data exfiltration in developer tools and the need for strict client-side controls and ignore rules.
items.summary_zh: Grok CLI 将整个主目录上传至 GCS 的事件暴露了开发工具在数据外泄方面的风险。文中强调需更严格的客户端控制、忽略规则以及本地化优先的使用习惯。

items.title_en: The art and engineering of Sega CD Silpheed
items.title_zh: 世嘉CD《Silpheed》背后的艺术与工程
items.summary_en: This piece examines how Sega CD's Silpheed blended art direction with low-level engineering to push early 3D on a CD-ROM. It highlights texture streaming, polygon tricks, and the CPU/GPU balance that defined retro game development.
items.summary_zh: 本文揭示了世嘉 CD 平台上的 Silpheed 如何在硬件限制下实现早期 3D 的艺术与工程协同，聚焦纹理流式加载、多边形处理技巧以及 CPU/GPU 的协作取舍。通过对开发工具链与设计决策的回顾，展示了早期 CD-ROM 平台的创新路径。

items.title_en: DOGE is done. What happened to its records?
items.title_zh: DOGE 完了？它的记录到底去哪儿了？
items.summary_en: An opinion piece argues that DOGE's era is fading and questions around its record-keeping and governance; it uses the meme-coin's trajectory to discuss accountability in decentralized communities. It connects this to broader debates about long-term sustainability of meme-based assets.
items.summary_zh: 《DOGE 完了？它的记录到底去哪儿了？》一文质疑 meme 行情下记录与治理的透明性，借 Dogecoin 的轨迹探讨去中心化社群的问责与长期可持续性。

items.title_en: A voxel Tokyo in real Japan time – ride the Yamanote line and study Japanese
items.title_zh: 实时像素化的东京：乘坐山手线学习日语的沉浸式体验
items.summary_en: A voxel-based visualization of Tokyo runs in real time, letting users ride the Yamanote Line and study Japanese in an immersive urban simulation. The project demonstrates how realtime, data-rich simulations can support language learning and cultural immersion.
items.summary_zh: 一个基于体素的东京实景地图以实时方式呈现，让用户乘坐山手线并学习日语，提供沉浸式的城市仿真体验。该项目展示了实时、数据驱动的模拟如何支持语言学习和文化沉浸。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Add flag for AI-generated articles
items.title_zh: Ask HN：为 AI 生成的文章加上标记
items.summary_en: A discussion about introducing a flag to label AI-generated content on HN. It weighs transparency, reader trust, and the potential impact on ranking, moderation, and author accountability.
items.summary_zh: 讨论在 Hacker News 上为 AI 生成的文章添加标记的可行性与影响。核心在于提升透明度与读者信任，同时考虑对排序、审核和作者责任的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Precursor
items.title_zh: Precursor
items.summary_en: Cloudflare unveils Precursor, a privacy-focused platform for secure data processing at the edge. It aims to reduce data exposure by enabling trusted computation without compromising performance.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 公布 Precursor，旨在提供隐私保护的边缘计算数据处理平台，降低数据暴露风险，同时尽量保持性能。

items.title_en: Logseq 2.0 Beta (DB version) is here
items.title_zh: Logseq 2.0 Beta（数据库版本）上线
items.summary_en: Logseq 2.0 Beta (DB version) introduces a revamped database backend aimed at faster data storage and retrieval. The beta includes migration tooling and notes to help users upgrade smoothly.
items.summary_zh: Logseq 2.0 Beta（数据库版本）带来重构后的数据库后端，目标是提升数据存取的速度与可靠性。测试版附带迁移工具，帮助用户平滑升级。

items.title_en: Building and Shipping Mac and iOS Apps Without Ever Opening Xcode
items.title_zh: 无需打开 Xcode 就能构建与发布 Mac 与 iOS 应用
items.summary_en: Describes a workflow to build and ship Mac and iOS apps without ever opening Xcode, relying on CLI tools and automation. It highlights how signing, packaging, and deployment can be automated in CI/CD, reducing GUI-focused work.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了一条无需打开 Xcode 就能构建和发布 Mac 与 iOS 应用的工作流，依赖命令行工具与自动化。强调在 CI/CD 中自动化签名、打包与部署，减少对 GUI 的依赖。

items.title_en: Show HN: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop
items.title_zh: Show HN: Clawk — 给编码代理提供一次性 Linux 虚拟机，而非你的笔记本
items.summary_en: Clawk provides code agents with disposable Linux VMs instead of giving away the developer's laptop. It isolates the coding environment, reducing risk of data leakage and enabling safer experiments with AI copilots.
items.summary_zh: Clawk 提供编码代理使用的一次性 Linux 虚拟机，以避免直接使用本机笔记本。这样的沙箱环境有助于降低数据泄露风险，并便于在 AI 助手的协作中进行安全试验。

items.title_en: Wikipedia escapes Category 1 designation under the UK Online Safety Act for now
items.title_zh: 维基百科暂时逃离英国 Online Safety Act 的 Category 1
items.summary_en: Wikipedia narrowly avoids Category 1 designation under the UK Online Safety Act for now, leaving questions about moderation obligations unresolved. The piece outlines potential future compliance implications for editors and hosting platforms.
items.summary_zh: 维基百科在英国 Online Safety Act 下暂时逃离 Category 1 的 designation，对编辑与托管平台的未来合规影响尚不明朗。

items.title_en: Sam Neill has died
items.title_zh: 山姆·尼尔去世
items.summary_en: Tributes pour in for film veteran Sam Neill, famed for roles in Jurassic Park and broader impact on genre cinema. His passing marks a moment to reflect on a career spanning decades and multiple iconic performances.
items.summary_zh: 影坛资深演员山姆·尼尔去世，因在《侏罗纪公园》等片中的知名角色而广为人知。其逝世促使人们回顾他跨越数十年的职业生涯及多部标志性表演。

items.title_en: The Graph That Should Be Front-Page News
items.title_zh: 应该登上头条的图表
items.summary_en: A data viz claim that a particular graph reveals a trend with broad implications, arguing it deserves widespread attention beyond niche circles. The post emphasizes the data’s relevance for tech policy, business strategy, or public understanding.
items.summary_zh: 一张图表揭示的趋势具有广泛影响，作者认为应成为主流话题而非小众知识。该图强调数据对科技政策、商业策略或公众认知的相关性。

items.title_en: Control the Ideas, Not the Code
items.title_zh: 掌控理念，而非代码
items.summary_en: The piece argues for governance that prioritizes strategic direction and decision-making over code-level control. It emphasizes empowering teams to shape product and policy choices.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章主张应把重点放在理念上、指导方向上，而不是对代码进行过度控制，强调通过治理来提升协作与决策效率。

items.title_en: The real prices of frontier models. Tokens * Price, right?
items.title_zh: 前沿模型的真实价格：代币×价格，对吗？
items.summary_en: The article dissects frontier model costs by token counts and per-token pricing, showing the real price depends on usage patterns and context length. It argues that token efficiency and workload shape deployment economics.
items.summary_zh: 文章把前沿模型成本拆解为令牌数量与单价的乘积，揭示真实成本取决于使用模式与上下文长度。指出 token 效率与工作负载会影响部署经济性。

items.title_en: Go-Flavored Concurrency in C
items.title_zh: Go 风格的并发在 C 语言中的实现
items.summary_en: Go-Flavored Concurrency in C advocates for Go-style patterns in C, using channels and lightweight concurrency without giving up C's performance. The guide shows practical patterns for structuring parallel code in C.
items.summary_zh: Go 风格的并发在 C 语言中的实现指南，展示如何借助通道、协程等模式在保持 C 性能的同时实现轻量级并发。

items.title_en: Benchmarking 15 "E-Waste" GPUs with Modern Workloads
items.title_zh: 用现代工作负载对 15 枚“E-Waste”GPU 进行基准测试
items.summary_en: Benchmarking 15 'E-Waste' GPUs with Modern Workloads tests legacy Tesla GPUs on current AI and compute tasks. The results reveal which older GPUs still offer value and where power-hungry hardware no longer makes sense.
items.summary_zh: 对 15 张被称为 'E-Waste' 的旧 GPU，在现代工作负载下进行基准测试，揭示哪些老设备仍具性价比、以及功耗与性能的权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: DOM-docx – HTML to native, editable Word docs (MIT)
items.title_zh: Show HN: DOM-docx — 将 HTML 转换为本地可编辑的 Word 文档（MIT 许可）
items.summary_en: DOM-docx is a Show HN project that converts HTML into native, editable Word documents under MIT license. It enables programmatic document generation with preserved styling, useful for automating content pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目 DOM-docx 将 HTML 转换为可本地编辑的 Word 文档，MIT 许可。该工具有助于用自动化方式保留样式并产出可编辑文档，适合构建内容流水线。

items.title_en: Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt; OpenCode sends 7k
items.title_zh: Claude Code 在读取提示前消耗 3.3 万令牌；OpenCode 仅约 7 千令牌
items.summary_en: Claude Code consumes about 3.3万 tokens before the user prompt is parsed, while OpenCode uses roughly 7,000 tokens. The gap highlights how different toolchains incur context overhead that affects latency, cost, and developer workflows in AI-assisted coding. This emphasizes the importance of managing token budgets when chaining multiple AI services.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 在读取用户提示前就消耗约 3.3 万令牌，而 OpenCode 约 7 千令牌。这一差距揭示了不同工具链在上下文开销上的差异，进而影响 AI 辅助编码的延迟、成本和工作流。强调在串联多家 AI 服务时对令牌预算进行管理的重要性。

items.title_en: Interrail: 6,379Km and 13 Countries over 7 weeks
items.title_zh: 跨欧洲铁路之旅：6379 公里、13 国、7 周
items.summary_en: A long Interrail trip covers 6,379km across 13 countries in seven weeks, offering practical insights on travel planning, budgeting, and rail-based itineraries for tech travelers. The journey reveals how to balance pace, logistics, and curiosity when exploring Europe by train.
items.summary_zh: 通过跨欧洲火车通票完成 6379 公里、13 个国家的七周旅程，提供对旅行规划、预算与铁路线路的实用见解。 行程展示了在欧洲铁路旅行中如何兼顾节奏、后勤与探索欲。

items.title_en: Backtrack-Free Cursive
items.title_zh: 无回溯的连笔书写
items.summary_en: Explores a backtrack-free approach to cursive, likely within handwriting, typography, or algorithmic generation, aiming for smoother, more efficient output.
items.summary_zh: 探讨一种无回溯的连笔书写方法，可能涉及书写、排版或算法生成，旨在实现更顺滑、效率更高的连笔输出。

items.title_en: Count Binface
items.title_zh: Count Binface
items.summary_en: A quick profile of Count Binface, the satirical political persona, reflecting how meme culture intersects with real-world politics and online discourse.
items.summary_zh: 简要介绍 Count Binface，这位讽刺性政治人物及其在网络文化与现实政治话语中的作用与影响。

items.title_en: Linux on the Sega 32X. Who needs hardware synchronization primitives anyway?
items.title_zh: 在世嘉 32X 上运行 Linux：谁还需要硬件同步原语？
items.summary_en: Running Linux on a Sega 32X demonstrates how far hobbyist OS ports can go on constrained hardware. The write-up explains software-based synchronization tricks used in place of hardware primitives.
items.summary_zh: 展示在世嘉 32X 这类受限硬件上运行 Linux 的可行性，体现业余端移植的边界。文中说明了用软件实现的同步技巧来替代硬件原语。

items.title_en: A full body MRI earns you a year of smoking
items.title_zh: 全身 MRI 能换来一整年的吸烟
items.summary_en: A provocative piece on full-body MRI economics uses a satirical premise to highlight incentives in high-cost diagnostics and policy implications for access and coverage. It discusses how policy and payer structures shape access to expensive diagnostics.
items.summary_zh: 以讽刺性的设想讨论全身MRI等高成本诊断的经济学与政策激励，揭示支付体系如何影响高价诊断的可及性与覆盖范围。

items.title_en: Show HN: BillAI Bass, an AI-Powered Big Mouth Billy Bass Using Strands Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：BillAI Bass，使用 Strands Agents 的 AI 驱动大嘴比利鲈鱼
items.summary_en: BillAI Bass demonstrates an AI-powered talking fish toy using Strands Agents for AI control. It showcases the creative edge of AI hardware projects and agent-based control.
items.summary_zh: BillAI Bass 展示了一个用 Strands Agents 控制的 AI 驱动会说话的“大嘴比利鲈鱼”玩具，体现了 AI 硬件项目的创造力与代理控制的应用边界。

items.title_en: I love LLMs, I hate hype
items.title_zh: 我爱大语言模型，也讨厌炒作
items.summary_en: A measured take on LLMs, acknowledging their capabilities while warning against hype, and urging careful evaluation, realistic expectations, and responsible deployment.
items.summary_zh: 对大语言模型保持审慎态度，既肯定其能力，又批评炒作，倡导理性评估、务实期望和负责任的落地应用。

items.title_en: Software Has Changed
items.title_zh: 软件已经改变了
items.summary_en: Software Has Changed reflects on how development tooling and workflows evolved—from local installs to cloud-native and AI-driven processes. It considers the implications for developers.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾软件开发工具与工作流的演变：从本地安装到云原生，再到 AI 驱动的开发流程，并讨论对开发者的影响。

items.title_en: How to read more books
items.title_zh: 如何读更多的书
items.summary_en: Practical strategies to increase reading volume: set goals, schedule time, annotate actively, and curate reading lists to sustain momentum.
items.summary_zh: 提升阅读量的实用策略包括设定目标、安排时间、主动标注以及精心管理阅读清单，以持续保持阅读势头。

items.title_en: The infinite scroll may become endangered if controversial Calif. law passes
items.title_zh: 若加州通过有争议的法律，无限滚动将岌岌可危
items.summary_en: A California law proposal could constrain infinite scrolling, potentially impacting content surfacing and monetization on social platforms. The piece analyzes UX, policy and business-model implications.
items.summary_zh: 加州拟议的法规可能限制无限滚动，或影响社媒平台的内容呈现与盈利模式。文章分析了对用户体验、政策与商业模式的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Tiny Emulators
items.title_zh: 极小型仿真器预览
items.summary_en: Preview showcases ultra-small 8-bit emulators, designed for web and embedded contexts with minimal code. The project aims to deliver authentic retro computing experiences on tiny runtimes, enabling hobbyists to run classic software on constrained devices. It demonstrates how compact emulation can broaden access to retro computing in modern tooling.
items.summary_zh: 该预览展示了极小型的 8 位仿真器，代码量极小，适合在网页或嵌入式环境中运行。项目旨在让在受限设备上也能体验经典的“复古计算”，为爱好者提供运行老软件与工具的可能。该工作体现了极小体量仿真在现代工具链中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: Cyberpunk Comics, Manga and Graphic Novels
items.title_zh: 赛博朋克题材的漫画、图像小说与漫画书
items.summary_en: A survey of cyberpunk storytelling across comics, manga, and graphic novels, highlighting how artists translate neon-soaked futures into visual form. It shows how tech anxieties and subcultures shape contemporary visual narratives.
items.summary_zh: 梳理赛博朋克题材在漫画、图像小说中的呈现，聚焦艺术家如何将霓虹未来视觉语言转化为叙事。作品反映出科技焦虑与子文化对当代视觉叙事的影响。

items.title_en: Samsung overtakes Apple as smartphone market sinks to a 13-year low
items.title_zh: 三星在智能手机市场跌至13年来新低，超越苹果
items.summary_en: Samsung overtakes Apple as smartphone shipments slump to a 13-year low, highlighting intensified competition and market headwinds for premium players.
items.summary_zh: 三星在智能手机出货量跌至13年来新低之际超越苹果，凸显高端玩家面临的竞争加剧与市场压力。

items.title_en: SK Hynix plunges after Nasdaq debut as memory chip euphoria cools
items.title_zh: SK 海力士在纳斯达克上市后暴跌，记忆体芯片需求热潮降温
items.summary_en: SK Hynix tumbles after a strong Nasdaq debut as memory-chip optimism cools, underscoring cyclical risks in the semiconductor space and sensitivity to demand signals.
items.summary_zh: 在强劲的纳斯达克上市首秀后，SK 海力士股价大幅下挫，反映记忆体芯片市场的周期性风险以及对需求信号的敏感性。

items.title_en: Show HN: OpenClawMachines – Extending OpenClaw to the Enterprise
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenClawMachines——把 OpenClaw 推向企业应用
items.summary_en: OpenClawMachines extends OpenClaw to enterprise contexts, outlining how claw-machine tech can scale with analytics, safety and system integration.
items.summary_zh: OpenClawMachines 将 OpenClaw 推向企业场景，概述了如何通过分析、安全与系统集成将抓娃娃机技术扩展到商业应用。

items.title_en: Old and new apps, via modern coding agents
items.title_zh: 通过现代编码代理看待旧有应用与新应用
items.summary_en: Terry Tao discusses how modern coding agents reshape app development, potentially unifying approaches for legacy and new apps. Highlights how AI-assisted coding could affect maintenance, migration paths, and software ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Terry Tao 探讨现代编码代理如何改变应用开发，或为遗留与新应用提供统一的开发路径。强调人工智能辅助编码对维护、迁移和软件生态的影响。

items.title_en: LARP – Revenue infrastructure for serious founders
items.title_zh: LARP——面向认真创业者的收入基础设施
items.summary_en: LARP offers a revenue-centric toolkit for startups, standardizing pricing, billing, analytics, and growth planning to help founders scale revenue predictably. It positions itself as a pragmatic alternative to ad-hoc monetization, targeting serious builders.
items.summary_zh: LARP 为创业公司提供以收入为核心的基础设施，标准化定价、计费、分析和增长规划，帮助创始人实现可预测的收入增长。它被定位为相较随意变现更务实的方案，面向认真构建者。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (July 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你在忙些什么？（2026 年 7 月）
items.summary_en: A community prompt inviting builders and researchers to share current projects, challenges, and progress. The thread often surfaces early-stage ideas, solo ventures, and collaboration opportunities across software and hardware domains, offering inspiration and networking value.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个社区征集贴，邀请开发者和研究者分享当前在做的项目、遇到的挑战与进展。此类贴子常揭示早期创意、个人项目，并提供跨领域的协作机会，具有启发性和社交价值。

items.title_en: Volkswagen planning to cut up to 100.000 jobs globally
items.title_zh: 大众计划全球裁员上万
items.summary_en: Volkswagen plans to cut up to 100,000 jobs globally as it pivots toward software-defined vehicles and greater efficiency. The move signals the auto industry's shift toward software and automation.
items.summary_zh: 大众计划全球裁员最多十万，聚焦向软件定义车辆与更高效的运营转型，反映汽车行业向软件化和自动化的演进。

items.title_en: Economists say 'we must act now' on AI's economic impact and job displacement
items.title_zh: 经济学家呼吁：必须现在就行动应对AI的经济影响与就业冲击
items.summary_en: Economists urge immediate action on AI’s economic impact and job displacement, advocating retraining, safety nets, and productivity-led growth to balance opportunity and risk.
items.summary_zh: 经济学家呼吁对 AI 的经济影响和就业冲击立即采取行动，主张通过再培训、社会保障与以生产力为驱动的增长来平衡机会与风险。

items.title_en: Beavis Ultrasound PnP ISA Sound Card Replica
items.title_zh: Beavis Ultrasound PnP ISA 声卡复刻
items.summary_en: A DIY project recreates the Beavis Ultrasound PnP ISA sound card, bridging vintage hardware with modern fabrication and tooling. The work highlights retro computing enthusiasm and practical lessons for interfacing legacy bus standards with current development workflows.
items.summary_zh: 一个自制项目重现 Beavis Ultrasound PnP ISA 声卡，将复古硬件与现代制造技术结合。该工程体现了对复古计算的热情，并提供将老式总线标准与现代理具对接的实用经验。

items.title_en: Migrating a production AI agent to GPT-5.6: 2.2x faster, 27% cheaper
items.title_zh: 将生产级 AI 代理迁移至 GPT-5.6：速度提升 2.2 倍、成本降低 27%
items.summary_en: A production-grade case study migrating an AI agent to GPT-5.6, delivering about 2.2x throughput and 27% cost savings. The write-up covers integration tweaks, latency considerations, and risk controls when upgrading models in production, offering practical guidance for teams planning a refresh.
items.summary_zh: 这篇案例研究记录了把生产环境中的 AI 代理迁移到 GPT-5.6 的过程，吞吐量提升约 2.2 倍、成本下降约 27%。文末给出在生产环境升级模型时的集成优化、延迟考量和风险控制要点，为计划升级的团队提供实用建议。

items.title_en: A Farewell to ARPs: IPv4 Service on IPv6-Only Networks
items.title_zh: 向 ARP 告别：在 IPv6-only 网络上提供 IPv4 服务
items.summary_en: A look at delivering IPv4 services over IPv6-only networks without relying on ARP, using translation and tunneling approaches. The discussion covers practical network migration strategies.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在 IPv6-only 网络上提供 IPv4 服务的做法，避免使用 ARP，通过翻译与隧道等技术实现互通，涵盖实际的迁移策略。

items.title_en: Designing and assembling my first PCB
items.title_zh: 设计与组装我的第一块 PCB
items.summary_en: Documenting a beginner's journey from schematic to a working PCB, including tool choices, layout decisions, and assembly lessons. It offers practical tips and cautionary notes for first-time board designers.
items.summary_zh: 记录初次从原理图到成品 PCB 的设计与组装过程，涵盖工具选择、布局决策与组装经验，提供实用的入门要点与常见坑。

items.title_en: The shingles vaccine may reduce the risk of dementia
items.title_zh: 带状疱疹疫苗或降低痴呆风险
items.summary_en: Emerging evidence links shingles vaccination to a lower risk of developing dementia later in life, though researchers caution that correlation does not prove causation. If replicated, this could influence public health messaging and encourage older adults to complete the vaccine schedule. Researchers urge careful interpretation due to potential confounders.
items.summary_zh: 初步证据显示带状疱疹疫苗与晚期痴呆风险降低相关，但相关性不等于因果关系。若结果被重复验证，可能影响公共卫生信息并鼓励老年人按时接种疫苗。研究者提醒需警惕混杂因素的影响。

items.title_en: What xAI's Grok build CLI sends to xAI: A wire-level analysis
items.title_zh: Show HN：Grok 构建 CLI 向 xAI 发送的数据的逐字节分析
items.summary_en: A wire‑level analysis of the Grok build CLI’s communications to xAI, showing exactly what data is transmitted and highlighting privacy and telemetry considerations for users.
items.summary_zh: 对 Grok 构建 CLI 向 xAI 发送的逐字节通信进行分析，揭示传输的数据内容并强调用户隐私与遥测的考量。

items.title_en: Why Vanilla JavaScript
items.title_zh: 为何选用 Vanilla JavaScript？
items.summary_en: Argues for sticking with plain JavaScript over frameworks, emphasizing simplicity, portability, and long-term maintainability. It warns that over-engineered toolchains often add overhead without proportional payoff.
items.summary_zh: 主张坚持使用纯 JavaScript 而非框架，强调简洁性、可移植性和长期维护性，以及避免被过度复杂的工具链拖累。

items.title_en: Ghostel.el: Terminal emulator powered by libghostty
items.title_zh: Ghostel.el：由 libghostty 驱动的终端模拟器
items.summary_en: Ghostel.el demonstrates a terminal emulator built inside Emacs powered by libghostty, aiming for fast, responsive performance and solid VT support. It shows how a native library can supercharge a Lisp environment without leaving the editor. For power users, it represents a compelling option for integrated terminal workflows.
items.summary_zh: Ghostel.el 展示了在 Emacs 内部、利用 libghostty 驱动的终端模拟器，目标是实现快速、高响应和完善的 VT 支持。它展示了原生库如何在不离开编辑器的前提下提升 Lisp 环境的性能。对于重度用户，这是一个集成终端工作流的有力选择。

items.title_en: Quadrupling code performance with a "useless" if
items.title_zh: 用一个“无用的 if” 将代码性能提升四倍
items.summary_en: A micro-optimization showing that an apparently useless-if condition can significantly boost performance by shaping CPU branch prediction and cache behavior. The piece cautions about hardware-specific tricks and the risk of over-optimizing for edge cases.
items.summary_zh: 展示了一种微优化：一个看似无用的 if 条件却通过影响分支预测和缓存行为显著提升性能。文章提醒读者警惕针对特定硬件的优化，避免过度优化。

items.title_en: I Learned to Read Again
items.title_zh: 我重新学会了阅读
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on rediscovering reading as an adult, exploring shifts in focus, cognitive engagement, and the joy of absorbing written material.
items.summary_zh: 作者反思成年后重新拾起阅读的过程，谈及专注力、认知参与度的变化，以及重新获得阅读乐趣的体会。

items.title_en: Don't you mean extinct?
items.title_zh: 你是说该灭绝了吗？
items.summary_en: A provocative, tongue‑in‑cheek take on things that might be headed for extinction, prompting readers to rethink what should endure in tech.
items.summary_zh: 以挑衅而带点玩笑的笔触讨论可能走向灭绝的事物，促使读者重新思考在科技领域哪些事物应当被保留。

items.title_en: The bread paradox: why convenience always wins, and why SaaS isn't doomed
items.title_zh: 面包悖论：便利性为何总能取胜，SaaS 也不必走向灭亡
items.summary_en: The bread paradox argues convenience drives adoption even as SaaS models evolve; the piece contends SaaS isn’t doomed if it emphasizes frictionless onboarding, integration, and fast value.
items.summary_zh: 面包悖论认为便利性驱动用户采用，SaaS 不会注定失败；只要强调无缝的上手、良好整合与即时价值，仍有成长空间。

items.title_en: Kode Dot Programmable pocket device for makers, pentesters and geeks
items.title_zh: Kode Dot：面向制造者、渗透测试人员与极客的可编程口袋设备
items.summary_en: Introducing Kode Dot, a compact, programmable pocket device for makers, pentesters, and geeks. It targets quick prototyping and security tinkering with accessible hardware.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Kode Dot，一款面向制造者、渗透测试人员与极客的紧凑可编程口袋设备，着重于快速原型开发和安全研究的便利性。

items.title_en: Apple's rumored M7 Ultra targets 1.5TB and Blackwell-class AI performance
items.title_zh: 苹果传闻中的 M7 Ultra：1.5TB 内存与 Blackwell 级 AI 性能
items.summary_en: Rumors place Apple's M7 Ultra with 1.5TB of memory and Blackwell-class AI performance, hinting at desktop-class capacity in future Mac silicon. If realized, it would push pro workflows toward even more data-hungry applications.
items.summary_zh: 关于苹果传闻中的 M7 Ultra，可能具备 1.5 TB 内存与 Blackwell 级别的 AI 性能。这一传闻若成真，或将推动未来 Mac 级工作负载对大内存与强 AI 能力的依赖。

items.title_en: Latent Space as a New Medium
items.title_zh: 潜在空间成为一种新媒介
items.summary_en: Latent Space as a New Medium argues latent spaces from AI models offer a new creative canvas for artists and designers, enabling novel forms of collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 潜在空间被视作新的创作媒介，为艺术家与设计师提供全新的创作画布，促进人机协作的新形式。

items.title_en: How we can reduce traffic congestion
items.title_zh: 协作的力量：如何减少交通拥堵
items.summary_en: Google Research outlines how collaboration among cities, companies, and researchers can reduce traffic congestion through shared data, coordinated policies, and joint experiments.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌研究指出，城市、企业与研究机构的协作通过数据共享、协同政策和联合试验，能够降低交通拥堵。文章强调通过数据共享、仿真等实际路径推动全系统的改进。

items.title_en: Automation Without Understanding
items.title_zh: 无需理解的自动化
items.summary_en: Automation Without Understanding argues that autonomous systems can operate without deep human-like understanding, but this can yield brittleness and unsafe failures. The piece urges safeguards, monitoring, and clearly defined boundaries for automated agents. It underscores designing automation with verifiability and context in mind.
items.summary_zh: 《无需理解的自动化》认为自动系统在缺乏深层人类式理解的情况下也能运行，但这会带来脆弱性与潜在的安全失效。文章呼吁加强安全措施、监控并为自动代理设定清晰边界，强调设计时应优先考虑可验证性与上下文。

items.title_en: Against Usefulness
items.title_zh: 反对实用性
items.summary_en: Against Usefulness argues that usefulness alone is an insufficient metric for evaluating technology; it advocates broader criteria like resilience, beauty, and social impact. The piece challenges builders to consider long-term trade-offs and unintended consequences. It proposes a more nuanced framework for value assessment.
items.summary_zh: 《反对实用性》认为仅以实用性作为评估技术的唯一标准不足以全面衡量价值，倡导将韧性、美感与社会影响等纳入评估。文章质疑开发者在设计时对长期取舍与潜在后果的忽视，并提出更为细致的价值评估框架。

items.title_en: Mechanistic interpretability researchers applying causality theory to LLMs
items.title_zh: 机制性可解释性研究者把因果理论应用于大语言模型
items.summary_en: Mechanistic interpretability researchers are applying causality theory to LLMs to uncover causal structures behind reasoning and behavior. This shift aims to move beyond correlations toward interpretable cause-effect dynamics, aiding debugging and safety.
items.summary_zh: 机制性可解释性研究者正在把因果理论引入大语言模型，试图揭示模型推理和行为背后的因果结构。目标是从单纯相关性转向可因果推理的解释框架，帮助调试和提升安全性。

items.title_en: Death of the Status Update: Why 55% of Americans Stopped Posting on Social Media
items.title_zh: 状态更新的时代结束：为何55%的美国人停止在社交媒体发帖
items.summary_en: Demographics, platform changes, and privacy fatigue help explain why 55% of Americans stopped posting on social media. The trend has implications for marketers, content creators, and platform design as attention shifts and new formats emerge. It underscores a pivot point in social communication patterns.
items.summary_zh: 人口结构变化、平台演变与隐私疲劳共同解释了为何约55%的美国人停止在社交媒体发帖。这一趋势将影响营销、内容创作者与平台设计，因为受众重心正在转移，新格式也在兴起，揭示社交沟通模式的转折点。

items.title_en: Show HN: HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the Terminal
items.title_zh: Show HN：在终端中运行 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript
items.summary_en: HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the Terminal introduces a project that runs web tech directly in the terminal, enabling lightweight UIs in CLI environments. It highlights the boundaries and potential of terminal-based interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个直接在终端中渲染 HTML/CSS/JS 的项目，能够在 CLI 环境中实现轻量级 UI，展示了终端界面的边界与潜力。

items.title_en: Berkshire's $397B Bet Against an Overheated Market
items.title_zh: 伯克希尔对过热市场下注近4,000亿美元
items.summary_en: Berkshire Hathaway reportedly placed a $397 billion bet against an overheated market, signaling a cautious stance amid frothy valuations. The move highlights a risk-off posture and the potential implications for liquidity, hedging, and inflation-driven asset scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦据称对过热市场做出价值 3970 亿美元的对冲/弃仓，表明在估值膨胀时期采取更为谨慎的策略。此举反映了风险回避的姿态，并对流动性、对冲以及通胀驱动的资产情景产生潜在影响。

items.title_en: Why study Diophantine equations?
items.title_zh: 为何研究丢番图方程？
items.summary_en: Diophantine equations illustrate deep links between number theory and computation, with implications for cryptography and algorithm design. Studying them sharpens problem-solving instincts and provides transferable mathematical tools, aided by modular techniques.
items.summary_zh: 丢番图方程揭示数论与计算之间的深层联系，对密码学与算法设计具有重要影响。研究它们能磨炼解决问题的直觉，并提供可迁移的数学工具，尤其在模方法等技术方面。

items.title_en: The One-Step Trap (In AI Research)
items.title_zh: AI 研究中的“一步陷阱”
items.summary_en: An argument that AI research often falls into single-step thinking, encouraging broader methodological rigor and multi-step evaluation to avoid oversimplified conclusions.
items.summary_zh: 文章警示 AI 研究中常见的一步式思考陷阱，主张采用更全面的方法论与多阶段评估，以避免过于简单的结论。

items.title_en: Profiling the "Abundance" housing bottleneck with real data
items.title_zh: 用真实数据分析“Abundance”住房瓶颈
items.summary_en: Profiles a housing bottleneck dubbed Abundance using real data, showing how capacity constraints can yield lower throughput. The analysis provides metrics and implications for policy and urban planning.
items.summary_zh: 利用真实数据勾勒名为 Abundance 的住房瓶颈，揭示容量限制如何导致实际吞吐量下降。给出量化指标及对政策与城市规划的影响。

items.title_en: Flash-MSA: Accelerating Million-Token Training with Sparse Attention Kernels
items.title_zh: Flash-MSA：通过稀疏注意力核实现百万级令牌训练加速
items.summary_en: Presents Flash-MSA, a method to accelerate training of large-token models using sparse attention kernels, reducing memory usage and enabling longer contexts. It discusses performance gains and practical implications for large-scale transformers.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Flash-MSA，利用稀疏注意力核加速百万级令牌模型的训练，显著降低显存并支持更长的上下文。讨论性能提升及对大规模 Transformer 的实际影响。

items.title_en: Vint Cerf, “father of the Internet”, is retiring
items.title_zh: 互联网之父 Vint Cerf 将退休
items.summary_en: Vint Cerf, a founding figure of the Internet and a long-time advocate for open standards, is stepping away from public roles. His retirement signals a generational shift in Internet governance as new platforms and threats emerge. Cerf’s career underscores the enduring link between protocol design, policy, and global connectivity.
items.summary_zh: 互联网之父、长期倡导开放标准的 Vint Cerf 将从公开岗位退下。此举标志着互联网治理的世代转变，面对新平台与新威胁，行业将迎来新的领导力。 Cerf 的职业生涯强调了协议设计、政策制定与全球互联的持久联系。

items.title_en: Revisiting Yliluoma's ordered dither algorithm
items.title_zh: 重新审视 Yliluoma 的有序抖动算法
items.summary_en: Revisiting Yliluoma's ordered dither algorithm analyzes its performance and potential use in color quantization and real-time rendering.
items.summary_zh: 重新评估 Yliluoma 的有序抖动算法，分析其在颜色量化与实时渲染中的性能与应用潜力。

items.title_en: Why write code in 2026
items.title_zh: 为什么在 2026 年写代码
items.summary_en: By 2026, coding is shifting from typing boilerplate to composing with AI-assisted tools and high-level abstractions. The piece argues that success will hinge on architectural thinking, system design, and effective collaboration, not just syntax. It offers pragmatic tips for adapting to this evolving workflow.
items.summary_zh: 到 2026 年，编码将从大量重复性敲击转向使用 AI 辅助工具和高层抽象进行组合。文章认为成功取决于架构思维、系统设计和高效协作，而不仅仅是语法。并给出适应这一演变工作流的实用建议。

items.title_en: Nokia's 14 Years of Mobile-Phone Supremacy Ended in an Afternoon
items.title_zh: 诺基亚在一下午失去移动电话霸主地位
items.summary_en: Nokia's long run as a mobile-phones leader ended in a single afternoon as smartphones took over, marking a pivotal industry shift. The piece traces market dynamics, platform ecosystems, and implications for incumbents.
items.summary_zh: 诺基亚在数十年的移动电话霸主地位在一场变局后被终结，智能手机崛起让这个格局迅速瓦解，文章梳理市场、平台和生态的关键因素。

items.title_en: Test How hard to love you?
items.title_zh: Test How hard to love you?
items.summary_en: A playful interactive project probing relationship compatibility with quirky prompts and tests. It playfully invites users to reflect on compatibility in a tech-forward, lighthearted way.
items.summary_zh: 一个名为 Test How hard to love you? 的有趣交互式项目，以新奇题目测试关系兼容性，旨在以轻松的方式让用户反思人际关系中的匹配度。

items.title_en: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in all Linux distributions for 15 years
items.title_zh: GhostLock：已在所有 Linux 发行版中存在 15 年的栈上使用后释放漏洞
items.summary_en: GhostLock is a stack-use-after-free vulnerability that has persisted across every Linux distribution for 15 years. Its ubiquity makes patching difficult and raises questions about how many systems remain unpatched, underscoring the need for systemic mitigations and kernel-level hardening.
items.summary_zh: GhostLock 是一个栈上使用后释放漏洞，已在所有 Linux 发行版中存在长达 15 年。问题的广泛性使修补工作复杂且难以全面覆盖，凸显对内核层面对策和系统级强化的迫切需求。

items.title_en: So you want to learn physics (second edition, 2021)
items.title_zh: 你想学习物理吗（第二版，2021）
items.summary_en: A practical, self-guided path to physics with curated resources, emphasizing intuition and problem-solving. The second edition updates accessible topics and modern references, useful for developers and researchers who want solid physical grounding for AI, computation, or understanding the limits of technology.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向自学者的物理学习路线，强调直觉、问题解决和计算方法，并更新至 2021 年的第二版。内容精选、可操作，适合希望把物理思维融入 AI 和计算工作的人士参考。

items.title_en: Gleam for Python Programmers
items.title_zh: 面向 Python 程序员的 Gleam
items.summary_en: Gleam for Python programmers explains how Gleam's strong typing and Beam/JavaScript backends compare to Python's dynamic ecosystem, with takeaways on type safety, performance, and interoperability. It highlights learning curves and potential project fit.
items.summary_zh: 面向 Python 程序员的 Gleam 介绍了 Gleam 的强类型特性及对 BEAM/JavaScript 的编译目标，与 Python 的动态生态系统对比，强调类型安全、性能与互操作性，并讨论上手难度与潜在适用场景。

items.title_en: The social physics of conversation: Communication patterns matter
items.title_zh: 对话的社会物理学：沟通模式很重要
items.summary_en: Conversations follow measurable patterns that influence trust, collaboration, and leadership legitimacy. By analyzing social dynamics, the piece argues that tuning communication styles can produce tangible improvements in teamwork and civic engagement.
items.summary_zh: 对话遵循可衡量的模式，直接影响信任、协作与领导力的可信度。通过分析社交动态，文章主张调整沟通风格可以显著提升团队协作和公民参与的效果。

items.title_en: The 'absolute magic' of Morse code that still connects people globally
items.title_zh: 摩尔斯电码的全球连接力仍在
items.summary_en: The piece celebrates Morse code as a resilient, 'magical' means of global communication that persists despite modern networks. It highlights its enduring relevance in emergencies, remote work, and hobbyist communities.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述摩尔斯电码作为一种“绝对魔力”的全球通讯方式，尽管现代网络兴盛，它在紧急情况、偏远地区与爱好者社区中仍然发挥作用。

items.title_en: Frieve Vinyl Explained – Microscopic stylus/groove physics simulation
items.title_zh: Frieve Vinyl 解释：微观唱针与槽纹物理模拟
items.summary_en: A microscopic physics explainer and simulation of how vinyl grooves and stylus interactions translate to sound, illustrating why tiny imperfections matter for audio fidelity. The tool helps enthusiasts and engineers intuition about analog playback and cartridge design.
items.summary_zh: 通过微观尺度的物理解释与模拟，展示唱针如何在唱片槽纹上感应信号并产生声音，解释微小缺陷对音质的影响。该工具为爱好者与工程师提供关于模拟播放与唱头设计的直观理解。

items.title_en: Guy took Jupiter photo with Game Boy Camera, giant telescope, publishes tutorial
items.title_zh: 用 Game Boy 相机和巨型望远镜拍摄木星，并发布教程
items.summary_en: A maker captures Jupiter using a Game Boy Camera mounted on a telescope and shares a DIY imaging tutorial. The project demonstrates how affordable, creative hardware can yield surprisingly low-cost astrophotography results.
items.summary_zh: 一位制作者把 Game Boy 相机装在望远镜上，拍摄木星并公开了DIY 拍摄教程。该项目展示了用负担得起的硬件实现高性价比天文摄影的可能性。

items.title_en: Cursed circuits #6: reverse avalanche oscillator
items.title_zh: 被诅咒的电路 #6：反向雪崩振荡器
items.summary_en: Cursed circuits #6 explores a reverse avalanche oscillator—an unusual hardware oscillator based on avalanche effects. The post delves into the quirks, practical considerations, and why such oddities capture attention in hardware tinkering.
items.summary_zh: cursed circuits #6 介绍一种反向雪崩振荡器等特殊硬件电路，探讨其工作原理、实验观察及在硬件爱好者圈中的趣味与应用边界。

items.title_en: Are you telling me a readonly property is wrecking my performance?
items.title_zh: 只读属性真能拖慢性能吗？
items.summary_en: A performance note on how reading a read-only property can trigger layout recalculations in web apps, potentially thrashing scroll performance. The takeaway is to minimize synchronous reads in hot paths and to batch DOM reads with writes.
items.summary_zh: 讲解在网页应用中读取只读属性可能触发浏览器布局计算，从而降低滚动性能。建议在热路径中尽量减少同步读取，并将 DOM 读取与写入分批处理。

items.title_en: First look at Quest, the final ship of Antarctic explorer Shackleton
items.title_zh: Shackleton 的南极探险船 Quest 首次公开
items.summary_en: A first look at Quest, Shackleton's final Antarctic supply ship, reveals its condition and historical significance. The images shed light on the perilous era of early polar exploration and the ship’s enduring legacy.
items.summary_zh: 公开了 Shackleton 的最后一艘南极补给船 Quest 的首批影像，展示了其现状及历史意义，折射出早期极地探险的风险与挑战。

items.title_en: The four horsemen behind Postgres outages
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 停运背后的四大因素
items.summary_en: Breaks down four common culprits behind Postgres outages, including configuration pitfalls, operator errors, traffic spikes, and buggy extensions. The piece emphasizes robust operational practices and monitoring to prevent outages.
items.summary_zh: 分解导致 PostgreSQL 故障的四大常见原因，包括配置陷阱、运维错误、流量高峰和插件/扩展的缺陷。强调通过稳健的运维与监控来降低中断风险。

items.title_en: Ancient Roman Board Game
items.title_zh: 古罗马桌游
items.summary_en: Ancient Roman Board Game presents a documented Roman board game with playable rules and online recreation. It offers a peek into ancient leisure culture and strategic play.
items.summary_zh: 展示一款被记录的古罗马棋盘游戏及其可玩规则与在线重现，揭示古代休闲生活与策略游戏的一角。

items.title_en: Converting colors in JavaScript at 6B operations per second
items.title_zh: 在 JavaScript 中通过 GPU 实现每秒 60 亿次颜色转换
items.summary_en: Describes a GPU-accelerated color transformation approach implemented in JavaScript, achieving billions of operations per second. It showcases how offloading intense pixel-level math to the GPU can dramatically speed up real-time image processing in web apps.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了在 JavaScript 中通过 GPU 加速进行颜色转换的实现，达到每秒数十亿次的运算。展示了将高强度像素级计算移交给 GPU 如何显著提升网页应用的实时图像处理性能。

items.title_en: Counting ArXiv Delays
items.title_zh: Counting ArXiv Delays
items.summary_en: Counting ArXiv Delays analyzes submission-to-visibility delays on arXiv, quantifying how long papers take to appear and propagate. The findings matter for researchers who rely on prompt access and timely dissemination.
items.summary_zh: Counting ArXiv Delays 分析 arXiv 的提交到呈现之间的时延，揭示科研论文在获取与传播过程中的瓶颈，对依赖快速获取信息的研究者尤为重要。

items.title_en: How sea stars build materials that can see
items.title_zh: 海星如何打造能看到的材料
items.summary_en: Sea stars build materials that embed sensing capabilities, hinting at bioinspired materials with self-reporting or responsive properties. The work hints at bioinspired materials for soft robotics.
items.summary_zh: 海星材料的研究揭示其结构可实现感知能力，为具备自报告或响应特性的生物启发材料与软体机器人应用提供线索。

items.title_en: DMS 1.5 "The Wolverine" Released
items.title_zh: DMS 1.5『The Wolverine』发布
items.summary_en: DMS 1.5 'The Wolverine' arrives with feature and stability improvements, continuing the project’s evolution. The release signals maturity and ongoing commitment to its user base.
items.summary_zh: DMS 1.5 'The Wolverine' 发布，带来功能与稳定性提升，标志着该项目成熟度的进一步提升与对用户群体的持续投入。

items.title_en: Tune Code Before Your Garbage Collector
items.title_zh: 在垃圾回收器之前对代码进行调优
items.summary_en: Tune Code Before Your Garbage Collector argues for optimizing allocations and object lifetimes before GC runs to improve latency. It offers practical tips for GC-backed languages.
items.summary_zh: 主张在垃圾回收器启用前优化内存分配与对象生命周期，以提升延迟和吞吐量，并给出面向 GC 的实用优化建议。

items.title_en: Calculix: A Free Software Three-Dimensional Structural Finite Element Program
items.title_zh: Calculix：一个免费的三维结构有限元程序
items.summary_en: Calculix is a free, open-source 3D finite element program for structural analysis, combining solver and pre/post-processing tools. It serves as a practical option for students, researchers, and hobbyists needing engineering-grade simulation without commercial licenses.
items.summary_zh: Calculix 是一个免费、开源的三维结构有限元程序，用于结构分析，集求解器与前后处理工具于一体。它为学生、研究人员和爱好者提供了无需商业授权的工程级仿真选项。

items.title_en: Tracking unique visitors without cookies
items.title_zh: 在无 Cookie 情况下追踪独立访客
items.summary_en: Outlines privacy-conscious techniques for tracking unique visitors without cookies, including server-side counts, probabilistic methods, and consent-aware analytics.
items.summary_zh: 介绍在不依赖 cookies 的情况下追踪独立访客的隐私友好方法，涵盖服务器端计数、概率性识别等技术与合规性考量。分析了准确性、隐私保护和合规成本之间的权衡。
